source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
From the left hand side of your screen, choose which appliance you wish to create a test record for.
3. Choose which test record is appropriate to the appliance being tested.
4. Under 'New Test Record' you'll see a pre-populated drop-down list. Simply choose the test that best represents the result of the failed test.
5. When you bring your cursor to the text field, you can either insert the same asset tracking information by clicking and holding the down arrow, or you can fill out the text field yourself.
6. Select a Reason for fail. This drop-down list allows you to choose a general reason for failing the test.
7. A description box gives you the opportunity to specify exactly why the appliance failed.
8. Finally, when you are happy that you've accurately recorded the failure of a test, press 'Approve' and follow the instructions to progress to the next screen
